entries.title: Isaiah 41:1
segments: ¶Keep silence before me, islands; and let the peoples renew [their] strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us draw near together to judgment.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:2
segments: Who raised up from the east him whom righteousness calleth to its foot? He gave the nations before him, and caused him to have dominion over kings; he gave them as dust to his sword, as driven stubble to his bow.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:3
segments: He pursued them, he passed on in safety, by a way he had never come with his feet.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:4
segments: Who hath wrought and done [it], calling the generations from the beginning? I, Jehovah, the first; and with the last, I [am] HE.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:5
segments: The isles saw [it], and feared; the ends of the earth trembled: they drew near, and came.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:6
segments: They helped every one his neighbour, and [each] said to his brother, Take courage.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:7
segments: And the artizan encouraged the founder, he that smootheth [with] the hammer him that smiteth on the anvil, saying of the soldering, It is good; and he fasteneth it with nails, that it be not moved.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:8
segments: But thou, Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham, my friend

entries.title: Isaiah 41:9
segments: --thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called from the extremities thereof, and to whom I said, Thou art my servant, I have chosen thee and not rejected thee,

entries.title: Isaiah 41:10
segments: ¶--Fear not, for I [am] with thee; be not dismayed, for I [am] thy God: I will strengthen thee, yea, I will help thee, yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:11
segments: Lo, all that are incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded; they that strive with thee shall be as nothing, and shall perish.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:12
segments: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them--them that contend with thee; they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:13
segments: For I, Jehovah, thy God, hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:14
segments: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith Jehovah, and thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:15
segments: Behold, I have made of thee a new sharp threshing instrument having double teeth: thou shalt thresh and beat small the mountains, and shalt make the hills as chaff;

entries.title: Isaiah 41:16
segments: thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them; and thou shalt rejoice in Jehovah, thou shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:17
segments: The afflicted and the needy seek water, and there is none; their tongue faileth for thirst: I, Jehovah, will answer them, [I], the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:18
segments: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and fountains in the midst of the valleys; I will make the wilderness into a pool of water, and the dry land into water-springs.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:19
segments: I will give in the wilderness the cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oleaster; I will set in the desert the cypress, pine, and box-tree together;

entries.title: Isaiah 41:20
segments: that they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of Jehovah hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:21
segments: ¶Produce your cause, saith Jehovah; bring forward your arguments, saith the King of Jacob.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:22
segments: Let them bring them forward, and declare to us what shall happen: shew the former things, what they are, that we may give attention to them, and know the end of them; --or let us hear things to come:

entries.title: Isaiah 41:23
segments: declare the things that are to happen hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods; yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be astonished, and behold it together.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:24
segments: Behold, ye are less than nothing, and your work is of nought; an abomination is he that chooseth you. ...

entries.title: Isaiah 41:25
segments: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come, --from the rising of the sun, he who will call upon my name; and he shall come upon princes as on mortar, and as the potter treadeth clay.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:26
segments: Who hath declared [it] from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, [It is] right? Indeed, there is none that declareth; no, none that sheweth; no, none that heareth your words.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:27
segments: The first, [I said] to Zion, Behold, behold them! and to Jerusalem, I will give one that bringeth glad tidings.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:28
segments: And I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, --and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:29
segments: Behold, they are all vanity, their works are nought, their molten images are wind and emptiness.
